seed_ledger.name: AES Indiana 2025 IRP power station 5 (gas supply)
seed_ledger.reason: NOT_FOUND: no source says how the unit gets gas. AES Indiana's plan adds gas only if a data center contracts, at Petersburg, Eagle Valley or Harding Street; no site chosen and no winner of the bid request found. The only lateral found is a one-mile Midwestern Gas Transmission lateral for the Petersburg coal-to-gas conversion, which has no data center tie. Searched: Inside Indiana Business (bid request, no pipeline), Indiana Public Media (conditional, none signed), Sierra Club release and IRP summaries (no fuel supply), power trade press on Petersburg conversion, IURC hearing list and search for dockets (nothing on a lateral), EIA projects workbook (no AES or Petersburg entry; local csv absent, checked via search), FERC and air permit searches (nothing), Eagle Valley and Harding Street pipeline searches (nothing), 2026 news on site selection (none). Searches run: 11.

evidence.note: May 2025 AES Indiana bid request, 600 to 800 MW combined cycle, sites Petersburg, Eagle Valley or Harding Street, no pipeline named
Oct 2025: 700 MW gas only if a data center contracts; none signed; no pipeline named

seed_ledger.name: Bay County power station (gas supply)
seed_ledger.reason: NOT_FOUND: Consumers Energy's Sept 2026 supply plan puts 456 MW of gas at Karn in Hampton Township for 2031 (919 MW at Thetford), with a hyperscale data center of up to 1 GW near final terms. Karn already burns gas on the existing system, and no source names a new lateral, pipeline or supplier. Searched: Consumers plan summary (no gas supply detail), WNEM and ABC12 coverage (none), Crain's Detroit (data center tie only), EGLE air permit for Karn (only an old operating permit modification), FERC pre-filing and Federal Register (nothing), Michigan PSC docket coverage (plan not yet decided, no pipeline), Hampton Township records (nothing found), Saginaw Trail link search (nothing), EIA workbook (no entry).
